[P2] Return to design for the reduced retention behavior

This changes what the public `truncate_record` function and exporters retain: the added repeated-name test drops six operations where the previous implementation drops only one. Existing consumers therefore lose operation data under the same configuration. Rule 1 (Keep it simple), item 3, requires breaking-change handling when an existing capability is removed; rule 3 (Write a design note before the code) applies to public API behavior changes, even with unchanged signatures. The description explicitly claims exemption from rule 3 because the API is unchanged. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and obtain agreement on the retention contract and release treatment. Consider preserving the existing retention behavior while addressing repeated rendering.
